nodes.label: LuneBrew Wordmark (traced vector geometry)
nodes.rationale: A two-line stacked wordmark reading LUNE / BREW in a geometric rounded sans, with the L of LUNE extended into a tall vertical stem that curves over into the U — a single continuous stroke suggesting a moon-arc and a pour. BREW is set on an italic/oblique slant and uses a doubled-W ligature. Base variant carries fill="currentColor", so it inherits the surrounding text colour rather than committing to a value; role="img" with aria-label "Lune Brew" supplies the accessible name. viewBox 4125x3393 with the classic potrace translate/scale(0.1,-0.1) flip, i.e. auto-traced from a raster original.

nodes.label: One Geometry, Three Fill Tokens (brand asset strategy)
nodes.rationale: The three SVGs are not three logos; they are one traced outline shipped with three fill values (currentColor / #111111 / #FFFFFF). Consequence: any retrace or kerning fix must be applied to all three or they silently desynchronise, and the currentColor base makes the other two redundant in any context that can set colour via CSS. The PNGs are raster exports of the two committed variants.
